name: Amirah R.
quote: I have carried the linen tote every working day since March, including through two downpours, and the handles have not budged. It has gone softer and somehow nicer looking.

name: Jo T.
quote: Ordered the sleepy elephant with my niece's name on the foot. My sister cried. It has been through the wash twice already and still looks new.

name: Priya M.
quote: She cut the sleeve to fit the exact paperback size I asked for. My books no longer come out of my bag with bent covers, which I did not think was a solvable problem.

name: Kenneth L.
quote: She sent me photographs of four batik panels to choose from before cutting. That is not the kind of service you get anywhere else at this price.

name: Hui Min C.
quote: My son has dragged this bunny around by one ear for eight months. The ear is still attached. I consider that the highest possible praise.

name: Sarah W.
quote: I missed the lantern rabbit last year and she remembered to message me when this year's batch went on. It now lives on our bookshelf all year round.

name: Denise K.
quote: Beautiful bundle and the handwritten note was a lovely touch. Only wish the throw came in a second colour, so I could have bought two without them matching.
